features.name: rsrp_normalized
features.definition: Clip (RSRP+140)/100 to [0,1]; clips signals outside [-140,-40] dBm.

features.name: candidate_user_rate_fraction
features.definition: CURRENT modeled candidate rate / configured user request; 0 if request=0.

features.name: requested_background_pressure_bounded
features.definition: p/(1+p), p=current requested background Mbps / nominal full-resource background Mbps; not actual utilization.

features.name: background_reference_utilization
features.definition: Current background-only reference utilization from radio model; not measured operator PRB data.

features.name: active_background_sessions_bounded
features.definition: Current active session count / (count+30); no future arrivals or departure times.

features.name: is_previous_cell
features.definition: One-hot cell left at most recent handover; all zero before first handover.

features.name: recent_handover_age_normalized
features.definition: Clip time since last handover / 3 seconds to [0,1], broadcast; 1 before first handover.

features.name: lookahead_distance_bounded
features.definition: Cell distance to the known-route one-step-ahead position / (distance+1000 metres); route lookahead assumed available.

features.name: interruption_remaining_bounded
features.definition: Remaining modeled handover interruption / (remaining+movement dt), broadcast.

features.name: last_interval_cell_utilization
features.definition: Realized modeled resource utilization averaged over last completed step; initialized to current background reference utilization.

features.name: last_interval_user_rate_on_serving_cell
features.definition: Last completed step user Mbps / configured user request on CURRENT serving node, other nodes 0; initial value 0.

interface_metadata.reward_formula: throughput_weight * (delivered_user_Mbps / throughput_scale_Mbps) * actual_duration_s - handover_cost * HO_event - ping_pong_cost * PP_event - weak_signal_cost_per_s * weak_duration_s
interface_metadata.reward_status: Starting, configurable research choice, NOT optimized or guaranteed to produce zero ping-pongs. Freeze after development; assess sensitivity before final claims.
interface_metadata.background_objective: Background delivered/unmet data reported separately. No global Jain-index bonus: one moving user cannot meaningfully control all 46 background populations.
interface_metadata.information_assumptions: Current simulator-wide radio/load estimates plus known-road-route one-step lookahead. Requires telemetry and route availability; not established for an actual phone.
interface_metadata.limitations: Partial observation: future profiles/arrivals/departures and seed omitted. No claim of Markov sufficiency, real-network calibration, learned traffic prediction, or GNN necessity.

spatial_mode_note: nominal keeps guessed location priors; shuffled permutes them per scenario; mixed alternates nominal/shuffled TRAINING episodes. Validation uses both modes only when mixed.
split_note: Training road paths differ from the six pilot validation paths, but can share road segments. NOT an untouched final test or an unseen-road generalization test.

coordinate_reference.projection: WGS84 ECEF to local east/north tangent plane
coordinate_reference.note: Zero ellipsoidal height assumed for ground positions. Not measured terrain elevations or antenna heights.

neighbor_graph_summary.assumption: Undirected distance-radius candidates. NOT operator neighbor lists, coverage overlaps, or guaranteed feasible radio links.
neighbor_graph_summary.message_graph: Neighbor links plus self-loops, for later GNN message passing.
neighbor_graph_summary.handover_neighbors: Neighbor links without self-loops. Later action masks must also check radio eligibility and permit staying separately.

coordinate_reference.projection: WGS84 ECEF to local east/north tangent plane
coordinate_reference.note: Zero ellipsoidal height assumed for ground positions. Not measured terrain elevations or antenna heights.

checkpoint_limit: Saved policies do not include optimizer/replay/RNG for exact resumption. Preserve run files and code.
selection_metric: Mean per-journey reward/s over fixed validation scenarios; not best throughput or a final test result.
experiment_note: Fresh native training. Only training route sampling changes; unchanged GNN, DDQN, reward and physical settings. 300-episode request uses complete journeys, NOT the reference step budget. Validation uses fixed pilot scenarios after episode1, every configured episode interval and final episode. Mobility is sampled from the existing road bank, not SUMO/Vienna replication.
route_sampling: Seeded shuffled bags, each training route once per bag; same route order across agent seeds. Two starts/site, NOT equal regional time or balanced destinations.
